description: Punjab Oil Mills Limited is an Islamabad-based manufacturer of edible oils and fats, making cooking and baking mediums and speciality fats under the CanOlive, Zaiqa, Naturelle and Tru Bru brands. It also markets a Naturelle foods range and Tru Bru coffee, and holds ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001, FSSC 22000 and Halal certification.
headOffice: Plot No. 26-28, Industrial Triangle, Kahuta Road, Humak Road, Islamabad, Pakistan
